title: UEFA Nations League A: Spain vs Croatia

market.source: Best prices quoted by Goal.com / Freetips previews; 1X2 is best-of-market (low margin)

context: Spain are world champions (2026); unbeaten in 39 internationals inside 90 minutes (29 wins); no home loss since 2022.
Spain conceded one goal in the whole 2026 World Cup, the fewest ever by a winner.
Spain 2026: ~63% possession, 16.7 shots per game, 6.3 shots against; ~89% pass accuracy; few cards.
Spain won 3-2 at England on matchday 1 after trailing 2-1.
Croatia (manager Slaven Bilić) won 2-1 in Czechia on matchday 1; won 3 of last 4.
Croatia at the 2026 World Cup: L 2-4 England, W 1-0 Panama, W 2-1 Ghana, L 1-2 Portugal (R32).
Seven of Croatia's last eight defeats came against top-10 ranked teams.
Head-to-head: Spain 6 wins, Croatia 3 in 10; Spain 3-0 at Euro 2024; 0-0 (Spain on pens) in the 2023 Nations League final.
Over 2.5 goals landed in 3 of the last 9 meetings.

style.home: Possession and positional play; wide isolation for Yamal on the right, Williams on the left; high press to win it back
style.away: Compact mid-block; Modrić/Kovačić to slow tempo and keep the ball; Budimir as the aerial target; set pieces
